goals.title: Panel heading on a socio's home page: the goals it works toward for the person.
goals.failed: Shown when the goals could not be loaded.
goals.none: Shown for an archived socio with no goals.
goals.empty: Shown when there are none; {{name}} is the socio's name (an AI agent).
goals.meta: A goal's status and its comment count.
goals.no-progress: A goal without a progress note yet.
scheduled.title: Panel heading: the socio's schedules that will run again.
scheduled.failed: Shown when the schedules could not be loaded.
scheduled.paused: A schedule's state instead of its next run time.
scheduled.running: A schedule's state instead of its next run time.
